calibration: none: the risk-date part fitted on risk-date label days only; unweighted gbm_classifier; scored under settlements dated from the auction announcement (metadata/settlement_announcement_dating.json), the settlement columns kept at every horizon and the coupon clause of the risk-date rule applied at h >= 2 and the H.4.1 weeklies read per release (metadata/h41_release_dating.json); with the rolling satiation level's distance as one extra input (satiation_dist_roll, variant (a) input); then, on the days that are not risk dates, the constant 0 is replaced by a day-level model fitted walk-forward on those days only: (b) as (a), in the gradient-boosted form (ml.PRESSURE_CLASSIFIER_SETTINGS: a HistGradientBoostingClassifier) on the four inputs and the state, with a monotone constraint of +1 on the state, so that a scarcer state never lowers the forecast; the interaction is the trees' own; metadata/off_risk_day_624.json
inputs_note: the parent's risk-date part unchanged, with a day-level model on the days that are not risk dates in place of the constant 0 (the declared inputs are in metadata/off_risk_day_624.json)
